---
name: 💡 Idea / teaching request
about: Suggest an improvement, or ask for a specific week/topic to be prioritized
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your idea related to a problem you hit while teaching or learning?**
e.g. "My students always get confused by broadcasting rules and the current Week 2 lab doesn't isolate that skill."

**What would you like to see?**
Be as concrete as you can — "a 10-min notebook just on NumPy broadcasting with 3 gotcha exercises" is much more actionable than "more NumPy".

**Which week/module does it affect?**
Week ___ / Module ___ / Not week-specific

**Would you be willing to help build it?** (even feedback on a draft counts)
- [ ] Yes — I can review a draft
- [ ] Yes — I can draft materials myself
- [ ] No, just requesting
